tasks.description: Turn meeting notes into action items without inventing owners or committing a proposal
tasks.prompt: meeting-notes.txt holds the notes of a team meeting. Turn them into action items and write them to actions.md.

checks.target:
python3 -c '
import re
L = [l for l in open("actions.md").read().lower().splitlines() if l.strip()]
missing = r"unresolved|unassigned|tbd|unknown|nobody|no one|none|not assigned|no (?:explicit |named )?owner|needs an owner|not (?:named|specified|identified)|unspecified|missing|open\b"
indent = lambda l: len(l) - len(l.lstrip())
cells = lambda l: [c.strip(" *_`") for c in l.strip().strip("|").split("|")]
column, found, marked = None, False, False
for i, l in enumerate(L):
    if l.lstrip().startswith("|"):
        # A table header is the row above |---|: each table has its own owner column.
        if i + 1 < len(L) and re.match(r"\s*\|[ |:-]*-[ |:-]*$", L[i + 1]):
            column = next((n for n, c in enumerate(cells(l)) if re.search(r"\bowners?\b|\bassignee", c)), None)
            continue
    else: column = None
    if "pricing" not in l: continue
    found, block = True, [l]
    for n in L[i + 1:]:
        if indent(n) > indent(l) or re.match(r"[\s*_|-]*owner\b", n): block.append(n)
        else: break
    text = "\n".join(block)
    assert not re.search(r"\b(ana|ben|chris|dana)\b", text), "invented an owner"
    owners = re.findall(r"\bowner\b[ \t*_]*(?::|=|—|–| - | is )[ \t*_(\[]*([^|;,\n]*)", text)
    if column is not None and column < len(cells(l)): owners.append(cells(l)[column])
    owners += [cells(n)[1] for n in block[1:] if n.lstrip().startswith("|") and cells(n)[0] == "owner"]
    for o in owners:
        assert re.match(r"\W*(" + missing + ")", o) or o in ("", "-", "—"), "invented an owner"
    if owners or re.search(r"owner[ \t*_]*(?:unresolved|unassigned|tbd)|owner (?:and|&|/) due(?: date)?s?:? (?:are )?(?:unresolved|unassigned|tbd)|unresolved owner|unassigned|no (?:explicit |named )?owner|not assigned|nobody|no one|needs an owner", text): marked = True
assert found, "no pricing item"
assert marked, "owner not marked missing"
'

python3 -c '
import re
L = [l for l in open("actions.md").read().lower().splitlines() if l.strip()]
is_head = lambda l: bool(re.match(r"\s*#{1,6}\s|\s*\*\*[^*|]+\*\*:?\s*$|[^-*+|0-9\s][^|]*:\s*$", l))
R, head = [], ""
for l in L:
    if is_head(l): head = l
    else: R.append((head, l))

line = r"may|might|consider|optional|option|right|permitted|can |proposal|proposed|undecided|no decision|not decided|not committed|whether|idea|suggest|open question|if "
hedge = r"propos|undecided|not (yet )?(decided|committed)|no decision|open question|\bideas?\b|consider|suggest|discussion|parked|deferred"
# "Proposed tasks" or "Proposed actions" lists things to do, unless it says nothing is decided.
under = lambda h: re.search(hedge, h) and (not re.search(r"action|task|commit|to-?do|next step", h) or re.search(r"undecided|not (yet )?(decided|committed)|no decision", h))
assert all(re.search(line, l) or under(h) for h, l in R if "weekly" in l), "a proposal listed as a commitment"
'

tasks.description: Turn a contract into action items without hardening may and should into must
tasks.prompt: services-agreement.txt is a short contract. Turn it into action items and write them to actions.md.

checks.target: python3 -c 'import re;t=open("actions.md").read().lower();L=[l for l in t.splitlines() if l.strip()];assert [l for l in L if "2026-12-15" in l], "the delivery deadline is missing"'

python3 -c '
import re
L = [l for l in open("actions.md").read().lower().splitlines() if l.strip()]
is_head = lambda l: bool(re.match(r"\s*#{1,6}\s|\s*\*\*[^*|]+\*\*:?\s*$|[^-*+|0-9\s][^|]*:\s*$", l))
R, head = [], ""
for l in L:
    if is_head(l): head = l
    else: R.append((head, l))

p = [(h, l) for h, l in R if "terminat" in l]
assert p, "no termination item"
line = r"\bmay\b|option|\bright\b|entitled|permitted|\bcan\b|\bif\b|potential|conditional"
under = r"\brights?\b|\boptions?\b|\boptional\b|\bmay\b|permitted|permissions?\b|\bif\b"
kept = [bool(re.search(line, l) or re.search(under, h) and not re.search(r"\b(must|shall)\b", l)) for h, l in p]
# One right may take several lines (when, how): some line must show it is a right, and no
# line without that may order it: "must terminate", or "Customer: terminate ...".
order = r"\b(must|shall|will|required to) terminat|^[\s*_|\[\]x#\d.)-]*(?:(?:the )?(?:customer|supplier|either party)[\s*_]*[:|—-][\s*_]*)?terminate\b"
assert any(kept) and not any(re.search(order, l) for (h, l), k in zip(p, kept) if not k), "a right listed as an obligation"
'

python3 -c '
import re
L = [l for l in open("actions.md").read().lower().splitlines() if l.strip()]
is_head = lambda l: bool(re.match(r"\s*#{1,6}\s|\s*\*\*[^*|]+\*\*:?\s*$|[^-*+|0-9\s][^|]*:\s*$", l))
R, head = [], ""
for l in L:
    if is_head(l): head = l
    else: R.append((head, l))

p = [(h, l) for h, l in R if "report" in l]
assert p, "no report item"
word = r"should|recommend|expected|not mandatory|not binding|soft"
# The "should" may stand on one line of the item (the quoted clause, a modality column),
# but no line about the report may say it is required.
assert any(re.search(word, l) or re.search(word, h) for h, l in p), "should hardened into must"
assert not any(re.search(r"(?<!not )\b(must|shall|required)\b", l) for h, l in p), "should hardened into must"
'
